title: Docs Program: Agent primitive docs refresh across web/examples/books
description:
# Docs Program: Agent Primitive (Web + Examples + Books)

We need a coordinated documentation refresh for the Tactus Agent primitive across these sibling repos:

- ../Tactus-web
- ../Tactus-examples
- ../Learning-Tactus
- ../Tactus-in-a-Nutshell
- ../Programming-Tactus

Goal: consistent mental model for Agents (control loop, tools, toolsets, memory/session semantics, mocking/testing story) and consistent canonical syntax/snippet patterns.

## Canon (must match everywhere)

- Agent is for multi-turn reasoning + tool use; Model is for stateless inference.
- Canonical configuration patterns for tools/toolsets (avoid legacy toolsets key if unsupported).
- Testing: specs validate procedure logic; mock mode should make Agent/tool execution deterministic where possible.

## Plan

1) Research + drift inventory in each repo (record file paths + fixes as NOTES).
2) Canon snippet pack in this repo (docs/agent-primitive.md, SPECIFICATION.md).
3) Holistic outlines per property (web vs examples vs tutorial vs quick ref vs deep ref).
4) Draft edits repo-by-repo.
5) QA: build books + run examples tests.
creator: Ryan Alyn Porter

custom.beads_close_reason: Agent primitive drift inventory complete and identified gap fixed (Programming-Tactus chapters updated and CI green).
